name: Airtel Africa
source: Airtel Africa plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026 (NGX corporate disclosure), consolidated statement of cash flows

rows.label: Capital Expenditure
rows.formula: Purchase of property, plant and equipment (753/736) plus purchase of intangible assets (122/123), as printed in the investing section

rows.label: Net Change in Cash
rows.formula: Operating + investing + financing; the filing prints the same 618 / 161 as Increase in cash and cash equivalents (a+b+c)

periods_note: columns dropped: FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
currencyNote: Airtel Africa reports in US dollars; the NGX doclib filing it is taken from is a USD statement. The share price quoted on the NGX is in naira and that is correct in the market record - only the statements are USD. Corrected because mixing a naira price with dollar earnings misstates every ratio by roughly the exchange rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
note: USD millions. Currency translation differences on cash (107 / -1) are printed separately by the filing and are not part of the net change line.
